meetings.title: Setter Performance & MDP Scaling Goals — EAXRVO
meetings.attendees: Elie Ashkar · Stephan Z · Abdallah Staitieh · Hanadi Hammoud
meetings.content:
Feb 5, 2026 — EAXRVO Meeting

SUMMARY
Elie Ashkar and Stephan Z discussed scaling MDP to 70–90 students and achieving $78K–$113K monthly revenue. Scaling identified as a "setter game" — setters must hit 10–12 bookings/day and 10% message-to-booking rate minimum.

KEY POINTS
• Pessimistic: 55% show-up + 35% close = $78K revenue
• Average: 60% show-up + 35% close = $85K revenue
• Optimistic: 65% show-up + 35% close = $92K revenue
• Best case: 70% show-up + 40% close = $113K revenue (132–151 students)
• Need 540 bookings/month = 18–24/day from 2 setters
• Setters can earn $2K+/month with bonuses if KPIs hit
• Lead center must be cleaned daily — categorize hot/no-show/dead
• 15% of Genesis leads are business owners → good MDP prospects
• Content creation + Google Ads to make MDP easier to close at $1.5K
• Out of 59 students, 58 were not "super sophisticated" — focus on freelancers

NEXT STEPS
• Elie to review lead center and ensure document is updated
• Send content creation brief based on pain points to group
• Talk to lead center team on daily KPI dashboard setup
• Find common ground with setters on booking targets for May
